title: Smart 1 creative plan
description: The contract between the OpenAI creative director and the renderer. Use this as the response_format schema for Structured Outputs so the model cannot return prose the application then has to interpret. The model chooses a layout_family from the registry and writes copy per size; it never emits coordinates.

layout_family.description: Must exist in src/templates. T04 and T09 require an offer or price.

image_prompt.description: Must end with an explicit prohibition on text: no logos, no lettering, no signage, no text. Headlines, logos and CTAs are composited by the renderer, never generated into the image.

orientations_needed.description: One master image will not crop well into both 970x250 and 160x600. Request separate compositions.

copy.description: Copy written per canvas, not shrunk from one master. `default` is the fallback; a size key overrides it field by field.

headline.description: 3-9 words depending on canvas. 3-6 for 728x90 and 320x50.

support.description: One short sentence. Omit entirely on 320x50.

cta.description: 1-3 words, specific to the next step. Prefer 'Get Estimate' over 'Learn More' for lead generation. Omitted for placements where the platform inserts its own CTA.

trust.description: One proof point only, and only where the size can carry it.
